zh.text: 歐洲央行Nagel：可能需要在利率方面做得更多。

en.text: ECB's Nagel: May have to do more on rates.

zh.text: 歐洲央行Nagel：我們預期2027年通脹持續高於3%。

en.text: ECB's Nagel: We expect inflation durably above 3% in 2027.

zh.text: 巨大的一週。週一暴漲，週三早上沖刷後全天反彈，然後強勢收盤進入假期。我們兩邊都玩。下週全是就業數據：週二 ISM，週三 ADP，週五就業報告。我們抓住了 $QQQ $MU $AMD $SMH $NVDA 等。本週最佳交易：$QQQ 11/25 626C，最高賣出 +204%。

en.text: Huge week. Ripped Monday, flushed Wednesday morning and bounced all day, then closed out strong into the holiday. We played both sides. Next week is all about jobs: ISM Tuesday, ADP Wednesday, jobs report Friday. We caught $QQQ $MU $AMD $SMH $NVDA and more. Top Trade of the Week: $QQQ 11/25 626C, +204% at the highest sell.

zh.text: @sunchartist 指出 $EURUSD 週線：法國按季及按年 GDP 下降進入衰退。標普將法國展望從穩定調降至負面。

en.text: @sunchartist notes $EURUSD weekly: France enters recession on QoQ and YoY GDP falls. S&P revises France outlook to negative from stable.

zh.text: 包括高收益在內的信用今年表現不佳。年初至今：$IEF -1.4%、$LQD -1.8%、$HYG -0.2%。掛扎因存續期而非信用。對衝存續期版本：$LQDH 3.1%、$HYGH 2.8%。貸款：$LONZ 3.8%、$SRLN 3.2%、$BKLN 3.1%。

en.text: Credit including high yield hasn’t had a great year. YTD: $IEF -1.4%, $LQD -1.8%, $HYG -0.2%. Struggle due to duration not credit. Duration-hedged: $LQDH 3.1%, $HYGH 2.8%. Loans: $LONZ 3.8%, $SRLN 3.2%, $BKLN 3.1%.

zh.text: @MikeZaccardi 指出本週最後一天，本月倒數第二個交易日，美元強勢，$DXY > 104。

en.text: @MikeZaccardi notes final day of the week, penultimate session of the month, and the dollar is strong with $DXY > 104.

zh.text: $BWET 的階梯式上升繼續... 如果伊朗人真的挑戰美國封鎖，我認為我們會回到 1000+。引用：從未想過 $BWET 海運 ETF 會成為對我 AI 投資組合的 phenomenal 對衝... 自幾天前的買入信號以來，緩慢但穩定的 30% 收益。在這種波動中是不錯的避風港？說這也很奇怪，因為美國和伊朗之間的和平協議會讓這個下跌 50%+。我只是不認為這會很快發生。

en.text: The $BWET stair-step continues... and if the Iranians actually challenge the US blockade, I think we'll be right back to $1000+. Quoting: Never thought $BWET marine shipping ETF would be a phenomenal hedge against my AI port... A slow, but stable 30% gain since the buy signal a few days back. Nice safe haven amid this volatility? It's also odd saying this, because a peace deal between the U.S and Iran would tank this 50%+. I just don't see that happening any time soon.
